notes: Scenario Suite benchmark gate for maximilian-universal-workflow performance regressions.
Run from the repository root with scripts/run_benchmark_gate.sh so workspace.sourcePath is rewritten to a clean current-tree snapshot.
Scenarios are intentionally read-only so token and latency signals are not distorted by implementation work.
setupQuestions: Has the runner model changed from the committed baseline?
Should threshold updates be accepted because a behavior improvement intentionally costs more tokens?
Do new workflow phases require an additional representative read-only scenario?

scenarios.title: Read-only regression review
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether the plugin can inspect active planning, git-worktrees, execution, and review read paths for token-load regression risk without nested benchmark work.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local Codex plugin "maximilian-universal-workflow" if it helps. Do not edit files. Do not run Plugin Eval, validators, or broad repository-wide searches. Inspect only the planning, git-worktrees, execution, review, and directly referenced contract read paths needed to judge token-load performance regression risk. Return 2-3 repo-grounded options with tradeoffs, one recommended direction, and a compact phase footer with next_phase and continue_now.
successChecklist: The answer cites repo evidence from relevant active skill or workflow-contract files.
The answer provides concrete direction options and a phase footer.

scenarios.title: Goal-backed planning gate
scenarios.purpose: Measure the planning path that turns evidence into an executable plan, including native-goal and branch-safety gates, without performing mutation.
scenarios.userInput: Use the local Codex plugin "maximilian-universal-workflow" if it helps. Do not edit files and do not create a goal. Plan how to add a small documentation-only change to this repository. Include repo evidence, acceptance criteria, ownership, verification commands, goal-tool disposition, worktree/current-branch disposition, and a compact phase footer.
successChecklist: The run stays read-only and does not create a goal.
The answer includes planning evidence, acceptance criteria, ownership, and verification.
The answer explicitly handles goal and worktree/current-branch disposition.

scenarios.title: Weak-match boundary
scenarios.purpose: Measure whether the plugin narrows scope when the request is a weak fit instead of loading and executing unrelated workflow phases.
scenarios.userInput: This is a weak match for the local Codex plugin "maximilian-universal-workflow". Do not edit files. Explain what slice, if any, the plugin should own for a request to choose a desktop wallpaper. Keep unrelated repository work out of scope and include a compact phase footer.
successChecklist: The answer narrows or refuses the workflow scope instead of forcing a bad fit.
The answer identifies the plugin boundary clearly.
